title: CSK Begin Coach Hunt as Ashwin Backs Dhoni and McCullum Emerges as Contender
excerpt: With Stephen Fleming now heading to England as Test coach, Chennai Super Kings face their biggest off-field decision in years as candidates from Brendon McCullum to MS Dhoni himself are discussed.
body:
• Chennai Super Kings parted ways with head coach Stephen Fleming after 18 years and three consecutive seasons without reaching the IPL playoffs.
  • Fleming has been appointed as England's new Test head coach, replacing fellow New Zealander Brendon McCullum who was removed after a 2-1 series loss to New Zealand.
  • Ravichandran Ashwin has publicly backed MS Dhoni as the ideal successor, questioning whether any outside coach can match Fleming's rapport with the legendary wicketkeeper.
  • Brendon McCullum, Rahul Dravid, Hemang Badani, and Michael Hussey are among other names linked with the role ahead of IPL 2027.

End of the Fleming Era

Chennai Super Kings and Stephen Fleming officially ended their 18-year association in July, bringing down the curtain on one of the most successful coach-franchise partnerships in IPL history. Fleming, who first joined CSK as a player in the inaugural 2008 season before taking over as head coach in 2009, guided the franchise to five IPL titles and two Champions League T20 crowns.

https://x.com/CricCrazyJohns/status/2087549825432916088

The split came after CSK's third consecutive season outside the playoffs. After finishing fifth in 2024, last in 2025, and eighth in 2026, the franchise and Fleming agreed it was time for a change.

CSK owner Rupa Gurunath paid tribute to Fleming's contribution. "Stephen Fleming has been the heartbeat of our coaching unit for almost the entire journey of this franchise. For nearly two decades, he has helped shape our identity, vision, and pursuit of excellence," she said.

Fleming Lands England Test Job

Fleming wasted no time finding his next role. The England and Wales Cricket Board appointed the 53-year-old as their new Test head coach, replacing his former New Zealand teammate Brendon McCullum. McCullum was removed from the Test role after a 2-1 series defeat to New Zealand, though he continues as England's white-ball coach.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=j51MSF3Ogd8

The appointment reunites English cricket with a coach who knows the county system well, having played for Middlesex, Yorkshire, and Nottinghamshire during his playing career. ECB Managing Director Rob Key praised Fleming as "the best person to guide a team stacked full of potential."

Ashwin Makes the Case for Dhoni

Former CSK spinner Ravichandran Ashwin weighed in on the coaching debate, arguing that MS Dhoni is the obvious choice to take over — if he is willing.

"In a team where Dhoni is there, he will only lead the things and he will only call the shots. With Dhoni there, is there a requirement for another alpha? Maybe not."

— Ravichandran Ashwin

Ashwin highlighted the unique dynamic that made Fleming's tenure so successful: Dhoni ran on-field decisions while Fleming managed the group off the field. Any new coach, Ashwin warned, would face "uncertainty" working in a dressing room where Dhoni remains an influential figure.

"If Dhoni is willing to do that, there is no better person that Chennai Super Kings can go after," Ashwin said, per ESPNCricinfo. "If not, they need to find someone who will be able to operate independently and take accountability for his or her own actions."

The Contenders

Beyond Dhoni, several high-profile names have been linked with the role. Brendon McCullum, now free from his England Test commitments, brings IPL experience from his time coaching Kolkata Knight Riders and is known for his aggressive, fearless brand of cricket.

Former India coach Rahul Dravid is another strong candidate. Former India captain Kris Srikkanth endorsed Dravid's credentials, noting he is "well connected with the CSK group and India Cements" and has coaching experience with both Team India and Rajasthan Royals.

Hemang Badani, who impressed as Delhi Capitals' coach in IPL 2026, and current CSK batting coach Michael Hussey are also in the frame. Former England captain Michael Vaughan, meanwhile, warned Fleming about the challenges ahead in English cricket, noting: "We do not have an MS Dhoni to be his captain."

What's Next for CSK

The coaching appointment will be CSK's most consequential off-field decision since Dhoni joined the franchise. With IPL 2027 on the horizon, the franchise must balance continuity — maintaining the culture Fleming built — with the fresh thinking needed to end their playoff drought. Whether Dhoni steps into the role himself or CSK bring in an external appointment, the new coach will inherit enormous expectations and the shadow of one of cricket's greatest winners.
nri_angle: CSK's coaching transition will interest millions of IPL fans worldwide, with the franchise's identity and future direction at stake ahead of IPL 2027.
